derivation: maxTotalRatio is the highest paired-round median ratio observed across four local runs of tools/measure-cli-command-timing.mjs (three at 2 warmup + 5 measured rounds, one at 1 + 3, all at 3 samples per round with the arms alternating), multiplied by 1.35 and rounded up to the next 0.05. Bounding the observed maximum rather than a wall-clock target is the shape packages/cli/test/daemon-multi-repo-lifecycle-cli-latency.test.ts already carries in enforcement. Every observedP50 below came out of the measurer; none of it is hand written.
